Your Mushaf, in calm

Begin each day with the Book of Allah: the Madinah Mushaf, nine classical tafsirs, 17 renowned reciters, prayer times, Qibla and Azkar. Free, ad-free, no sign-up.

Everything in Taybah

The Mushaf

The Madinah Mushaf, three reading modes and fast search.

Tafsir

Nine classical Arabic tafsirs to download and read offline.

Prayer and Qibla

Times, notifications, the adhan and a Qibla compass.

Listening

17 reciters, ayah repeat, a sleep timer and offline listening.

Azkar and Misbaha

Hisn al-Muslim with counters and audio, and a digital misbaha.

Your daily wird

Khatma, daily goals, reminders, bookmarks and notes.

Hijri calendar and moon

The Umm al-Qura calendar, occasions and on-device moon sighting.

Widgets and Apple Watch

Times, the misbaha and Azkar status on your Home Screen and wrist.

Crafted with care

Arabic first, in light, sepia and dark, on every screen.

All features in detail

On every screen

  • iPhone and Android

    A layout that fits every phone, foldables included.

  • iPad and tablets

    The mushaf and tafsir side by side on large screens.

  • Apple Watch

    Your next prayer, the misbaha and Azkar status on your wrist.

  • Widgets

    Times, progress, your reading place and counts, never Quran text.

Your privacy is an amanah

  • No account, no sign-in.

  • No ads, no tracking.

  • Your bookmarks, notes and Khatma stay on your device alone.

Privacy Policy

The text, exactly as received

Not a letter of the Quran text is changed, and we generate no religious content with AI: no summaries, rewrites or translations. Every tafsir and recitation names its author or reciter.
